description.p: Lunarians are an extraordinarily rare people believed to be descendants of the Moon itself—or shaped so completely by lunar influence that the distinction no longer matters. Deeply attuned to magic and the night sky, Lunarians perceive arcane forces instinctively, reacting to spells and supernatural phenomena in ways that often defy mortal logic.

They age slowly, experience time differently, and are known for emotional intensity and fixation. To Lunarians, obsession is not a flaw but a natural consequence of lunar influence—a narrowing of focus that can last decades or centuries.
Two forms of Lunarians exist: Pure Lunarians, whose bodies fully reflect their lunar heritage, and Lunar-Touched, members of other ancestries altered by the Moon’s influence.
Your Lunarian character has the following racial traits.
Ability Score Increase. Your ability score increases are determined by your Lunarian Origin.
Size. Lunarians are Medium humanoids.
Speed. Your base walking speed is 35 feet.

Age. Lunarians mature at a rate similar to humans, but age far more slowly. Pure Lunarians commonly live between 800 and 1,000 years. Lunar-Touched Lunarians live significantly longer than members of their origin ancestry, often reaching twice the expected lifespan.
Languages. You can speak, read, and write Common and two other languages of your choice.
Arcane Training. You gain proficiency in the Arcana skill. In addition, you gain proficiency in either Perception or Performance, your choice.

Lunar Perception. You possess heightened awareness shaped by lunar and arcane influence. You have blindsight out to a range of 20 feet. Within this range, you perceive creatures and objects through subtle shifts in magic, light, and presence rather than sight alone.

Lunar Glow. You can channel soft lunar radiance. Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you emit moonlight in a 5-foot radius of bright light, with dim light for an additional 10 feet. This light lasts for 10 minutes or until you dismiss it, no action required.

Arcane Sensitivity. You instinctively react to magical threats. Once per long rest, when you are required to make a saving throw against a spell, you can choose to gain advantage on that saving throw. You can use this trait even if you cannot see the source of the spell. You must choose to use this trait before rolling.
Lunarian Origin. Choose one of the following origins at character creation.
Pure Lunarians are fully shaped by lunar influence, both physically and spiritually.
Ability Score Increase. Increase one of your Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma scores by 2, and increase your Dexterity score by 1.

Lunar Melody. Your body recovers in harmony with lunar rhythm. When you spend Hit Dice to regain hit points during a short rest, you regain the maximum number of hit points possible for each Hit Die spent. In addition, you require only 6 hours to complete a long rest.
Lunar-Touched Lunarians are members of other ancestries marked by prolonged exposure to lunar power.
Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, and increase a different ability score of your choice by 1.

Ecliptic Surge. Once per short rest, after you roll a d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw and determine the result, you can choose to add your proficiency bonus to the roll. This bonus is added in addition to any proficiency bonus already applied. You can use this trait after seeing the roll, but before the outcome is resolved.

Pure Lunarians typically possess prominent rabbit-like ears and a small, rounded scut. Their features often appear soft or pale, and their irises may seem dusted with glitter or starlight when interacting with magic.

All Lunarians—Pure and Lunar-Touched alike—exhibit lunar reactions. When using Lunar Glow, casting spells, or standing beneath moonlight, subtle signs may appear: hair emitting a faint glow, arcane markings along the skin becoming visible, and eyes reflecting pale lunar light.
Lunar-Touched Lunarians otherwise resemble their origin ancestry, with only these reactions and their extended lifespan marking them as lunar.

Pure Lunarians invariably develop an obsession—an idea, object, practice, belief, or fixation that shapes their behavior for years or centuries. This is widely understood as a natural consequence of lunar influence rather than madness.
Lunar-Touched Lunarians tend to retain the psychology of their origin race, though many report heightened emotion, intuition, or restlessness beneath the night sky.
